body:
INTEGRATOR READINESS / HANDOFF (independent assessment, no code, no merge, nothing mutated)
Assessed 2026-11-01 ~01:20 PDT against live forge. main = 9d26f95d2b36 (BUG-2378).
Train 3196 (PR-3199 @ 3079527d) is in flight: 7/8 CI green, CI (contracts) still pending; mergeState BLOCKED. Not touched. PR-3196 is docs/showcase only; no file overlap with 3197 or 3195.

ELIGIBLE (run only after train 3196 has landed or ended):

  aida pr train 3197 3195

PR-3197 BUG-2397 (codex doer), fix(mailbox) wake units
  - pinned approved head 891f8747f5285754b35a277ec40df828a97824f4 == current forge head
  - verdict APPROVED at 891f874 by the reviewer seat (grant 40c329bc, session 01a1961b8690), not the doer or root advisor. Gate ledger PR-3197 seq 3, patch-id f337d1e3, base 9d26f95
  - CI: all 9 jobs SUCCESS at head, merge-hold-gate SUCCESS. Mergeable CLEAN. No .aida/merge-holds marker
  - spec Done, tag closure:pending (AC3 is a live action after the merge; leave the tag). Non-blocking finding (enable --now does not restart an already-active unit) is recorded on the spec
PR-3195 STORY-2243 (claude doer), feat(goal) advisor goal
  - pinned approved head 84546ca60f08c07f7c45d8534ac8520727cee4a7 == current forge head
  - verdict APPROVED at 84546ca by claude-reviewer seat (grant 90264ad8, session 01a1961118d9). Ledger PR-3195 seq 6, patch-id afef61e8. The later seq 7-9 entries are only the automatic supervised-hold release at 84546ca. Their "CHANGES REQUESTED at e796e01" detail refers to the earlier round, not the current head
  - CI: all jobs SUCCESS. The current merge-hold-gate run passes; the older failing run is superseded. Mergeable CLEAN. No hold marker
  - Non-blocking findings (the trace parser drops the '.Vendor-neutral' label, so AC9 shows as untraced; toon goal text is unescaped) are on the spec
  - supervised: lands only for the human-TTY runner that names the PR. The operator terminal train covers that
Order: 3197 first (3 files), then 3195. There is no file overlap between the two. Both approvals were recorded on base 9d26f95, so after 3196 lands they carry over as a clean merge from main. The train's patch-id check enforces this, and no update-branch is needed. If the train drops either PR for patch-id drift, it needs a fresh independent review. Do not carry the approval over by hand.

HELD: PR-3185 STORY-2204. Real blocker, not waived:
  - forge mergeable CONFLICTING / DIRTY against main 9d26f95. It most likely conflicts with BUG-2378, which touches the same id-allocation and backfill area. The train would leave it out as conflicting
  - approval APPROVED is pinned at f3132074d230c705dd5e488c68e2bce3729a866e (ledger seq 19, reviewer grant 1fd0d4ef). CI at that head is SUCCESS apart from the supervised merge-hold-gate red
  - architecture: the sketch and the ADVISOR SIGNOFF 13:56 (with a scope cut to STORY-170) are present on the spec
  - Needed: the doer resolves the conflict with main (the integrator did not update the branch, per the brief). Then a fresh independent review at the new head, because a conflict resolution is not a clean carry-over. Then green CI. Then it can join a later operator train: aida pr train 3185
subject: Integrator readiness: train 3197 3195 after 3196; 3185 held (conflict)
